title: Fit Log
shortDescription: A workout and fitness web application designed to help users explore workouts and organize their fitness routine.
description: Fit Log is a fitness-focused web project featuring a workout library and workout planning experience. It demonstrates my ability to build structured interfaces and work with modern web technologies.
challenges: Structuring exercise routine data efficiently for intuitive client-side browsing
Designing responsive card grids that remain legible on small mobile viewports during workout sessions
Handling asynchronous REST API responses cleanly with fallback states
learnings: Implementing reusable component architecture with Next.js and Tailwind CSS
Creating seamless user interactions for filtering and navigating workout categories
Optimizing web performance and layout shifts for media-rich fitness cards

title: Fresh Mart
shortDescription: A fresh grocery shopping website focused on presenting products through a clean shopping interface.
description: Fresh Mart is a grocery-related web project built to present products in an organized and user-friendly interface. The project can be showcased as an example of my frontend development and responsive UI work.
challenges: Crafting custom responsive layouts using pure CSS flexbox and grid without utility frameworks
Implementing dynamic client-side filtering and item discovery using vanilla JavaScript DOM manipulation
Ensuring consistent cross-browser typography and card alignment
learnings: Solidified foundational DOM scripting and event-driven JavaScript programming
Strengthened semantic HTML5 accessibility and mobile-first CSS architecture
Deploying and managing static web applications via GitHub Pages

title: DevStack
shortDescription: A developer-focused web project showcasing technology-related content in a structured interface.
description: DevStack is a web project in my development portfolio. Use this page to present its actual purpose, key features, implementation decisions, and the technical skills demonstrated by the project.
challenges: Designing a cohesive dark aesthetic tailored specifically for developer-facing tools
Breaking down complex views into modular, reusable React functional components
Managing UI state effectively across interactive tabs and technology filters
learnings: Advanced utility-first styling patterns using modern Tailwind CSS
Component composition and props management in React applications
Polishing user experience with smooth hover transitions and micro-interactions
